description: This PHP class defines a form processor for handling impact data related to projects within the Goteo project. It includes methods to generate impact data choices based on impact data list or footprint, build the form with fields such as impact data selection, estimation amount, and data, and save the form data to the impact data model.

classes.name: ImpactDataProjectForm
classes.description: A form processor class for handling impact data related to projects, including building and saving form data.

methods.name: getImpactDataList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of impact data excluding manual sources, returning an array suitable for form choices.

methods.name: getImpactDataListByFootprint
methods.description: Retrieves impact data list filtered by a specific footprint.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with impact data selection, estimation amount, data, and submit button.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the submitted form data into the impact data model.
